plugin.name: Obsidian Companion
plugin.description: Seamless Obsidian vault companion with live tasks indicator, quick capture, tag browsing, and sync.

bar.clickAction: LMB: Open Hub · RMB: Context Menu · MMB: Quick Capture

panel.title: Obsidian Vault
panel.noTasksFound: No markdown tasks found in today's note
panel.quickCapturePlaceholder: Add a task or note... (Enter to submit)

settings.vaultPathDesc: Absolute path to your local Obsidian vault directory
settings.dailyFolderDesc: Relative folder path for daily notes within the vault (e.g. DAILY)
settings.dailyFormatDesc: Date naming convention for daily notes (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY)
settings.inboxFileDesc: Filename for loose notes or inbox capture (e.g. INBOX.md)
settings.preferredEditorDesc: Default application used to open daily notes and markdown files
settings.showBadgeDesc: Display task count indicator next to the Obsidian bar icon
settings.badgeModeDesc: How the task count is displayed
settings.refreshIntervalDesc: How often to check for note and task updates: {seconds}s
settings.syncServiceDesc: User systemd service name for vault synchronization (e.g. rclone-obsidian-sync.service)
settings.panelPositionDesc: Where the Obsidian Hub panel appears on screen
